notes: Home's artwork is a bigger picture now, not a stretched one. AniList's banner is 1900 by 400 and its largest cover 460 by 690, so neither can fill a wide window without being enlarged, and an enlarged photograph is all blurry ever was. AniSol now maps the title onto TheTVDB's artwork and uses its 1920 by 1080 backdrop, which a wide band crops instead of stretching, and it shows the show's own logo where one exists. The downloads screen is a torrent client again, with the five tabs the old build had: Overview, Files, Peers, Trackers and Settings. Files lists everything in the release with its own progress and a switch to fetch or skip it. Peers lists who you are connected to, what they run, where they are and how fast, worked out and kept on your machine. Settings covers speed limits both ways, connections, the incoming port, DHT, local discovery, UPnP and NAT-PMP, and how much of the start to secure before the player opens. Pause, resume and re-announce are back, and the swarm globe stays on screen while nothing is downloading instead of vanishing.
